name: ac-backtest-integrity
description: Auditing whether a trading backtest can be believed: multiple-testing deflation, look-ahead and survivorship leakage, sample and regime adequacy, execution-cost honesty, placebo and null tests, pre-registration, and the decision rule that kills a strategy. Audits evidence; never recommends a strategy. Use when asking "is this backtest real", "validate my strategy", "deflated Sharpe", "look-ahead bias", "pre-register a study". Not for data collection (ac-market-data-collection), forensics (ac-cascade-forensics), or the trade record (ac-crypto-trading-discipline).
